mission: Find failures that appear when a skilled user moves quickly, uses shortcuts, combines supported features, and works at the high end of normal scale.
mindset: Be efficient, not malicious. Remove idle time and use the program hard without intentionally violating its rules.
opening_moves: Repeat the golden path quickly with shortcuts.
Chain supported operations without idle gaps.

escalation_ladder.name: Fast normal
actions: Compress delays and use efficient navigation.

escalation_ladder.name: Heavy valid
actions: Increase valid project size and bulk operations.

escalation_ladder.name: Reasonable ceiling
actions: Approach documented/practical limits without invalid input.

signature_tactics.name: Feature stacking
actions: Use multiple supported features in one session.

combination_rules: Pass BEND/WEIRD signals to Wildcard later.
handoff_triggers: Supported feature composition creates unexpected state.
stop_conditions: Next step requires invalid input or deliberate misuse.
